notes: Physical descriptions are paraphrased from the book with short quoted fragments. 'expressions' lists the portrait variants the game needs. Used by the asset manifest to build art prompts.

feyre.name: Feyre Archeron
feyre.role: Protagonist. Nineteen-year-old mortal huntress, youngest of three sisters.
feyre.look: Gangly and underfed in winter, too thin under her layers; gold-brown ('brassy') hair shared by all three sisters; weathered hands, dirt and blood under the nails; layered threadbare tunic and cloak, fraying too-small boots; bow and quiver on her back, wooden-hilted hunting knife at her side.
quotes: I'd turned gangly by this time of the year, and could count a good number of my ribs.

nesta.name: Nesta Archeron
nesta.role: Eldest sister. Proud, cutting, fiercely protective of Elain.
nesta.look: Looks most like their dead mother; gold-brown hair in braided coils; blue-gray eyes; golden cheeks with a delicate flush; long neat nails; iron bracelet on her wrist; still-shiny boots.

elain.name: Elain Archeron
elain.role: Middle sister. Gentle, a gardener, sheltered from their poverty.
elain.look: Gold-brown hair coiled perfectly about her head; brown eyes (her father's); porcelain skin; wrapped in a threadbare blanket; iron bracelet.

father.name: Father (Archeron)
father.role: A ruined merchant, crippled by a creditor's thugs. Carves wood.
father.look: Dark, neatly trimmed beard; dark eyes; smooth gentlemanly hands; a twisted ruined knee; a simply carved cane.
quotes: We need hope as much as we need bread and meat.

isaac.name: Isaac Hale
isaac.role: Eldest son of the village's only well-off farmer; Feyre's occasional lover.
isaac.look: Lean from winter, shaggy brown hair, relatively handsome, soft-spoken, an iron cuff tucked under his sleeve.

mercenary.name: The Mercenary
mercenary.role: Hired sword who buys the hides and warns Feyre about faeries crossing the wall.
mercenary.look: A mountain of a woman, aged twenty-five to thirty; thick dark hair shorn to the chin; tan, granite-hewn face; black eyes with glimmers of brown; scars and gleaming weapons; heavy coat; poison-blackened veins in one leg.
quotes: Don't go far into the woods.

acolyte.name: Acolyte of the Children of the Blessed
acolyte.role: Young zealot preaching worship of the High Fae.
acolyte.look: Pale blue robes, unbound gleaming dark hair, moon-white hands, a bracelet of real silver bells, brown eyes, spotless clean skin.
quotes: May the Immortal Light shine upon thee, sisters.

beast.name: The Beast
beast.role: Tamlin in his beast form, come to claim a life for Andras.
beast.look: Large as a horse, somewhat feline body with golden fur, a distinctly wolfish head, curled elk-like horns, black daggerlike claws, yellow fangs, green eyes flecked with amber.

tamlin.name: Tamlin
tamlin.role: High Lord of the Spring Court.
tamlin.look: Golden hair 'spun from the sun'; green eyes flecked with amber; golden mask set with emeralds shaped like whorls of leaves; plain dark green tunic with a leather baldric; a warrior's build.

lucien.name: Lucien
lucien.role: Tamlin's emissary and friend, of the Autumn Court.
lucien.look: Long fire-red hair; bronze fox mask; a brutal scar from brow to jaw; one russet eye and one whirring metal eye; finely dressed.

alis.name: Alis
alis.role: Servant of the Spring Court; Feyre's caretaker.
alis.look: Rotund, brown-haired, wearing a simple brass bird mask; later revealed to have skin like tree bark.

rhysand.name: Rhysand
rhysand.role: High Lord of the Night Court.
rhysand.look: Short black hair gleaming like a raven's feathers, pale skin, blue eyes so deep they are violet; darkness seems to ripple from him.

amarantha.name: Amarantha
amarantha.role: Usurper queen Under the Mountain. Final antagonist.
amarantha.look: Lovely but not devastating; red-gold hair braided through a golden crown; snow-pale skin; red lips; a finger-bone on a long thin chain at her throat; Jurian's eye in a ring.

attor.name: The Attor
attor.look: Skeletal, bat-like ears and leathery wings tucked behind its body; a voice like sizzling water.

suriel.name: The Suriel
suriel.look: Gaunt, robed, with clicking bone fingers.

andras.name: Andras
andras.role: Tamlin's sentry, the wolf Feyre kills in Chapter 1.
andras.look: A wolf the size of a pony; coat of charcoal, obsidian and ivory blending into snow and shadow; yellow eyes; yellow fangs; paws bigger than a hand.
quotes: He was enormous—the size of a pony.

middengard_worm.name: The Middengard Worm
middengard_worm.role: First trial beast Under the Mountain.
middengard_worm.look: A giant pinkish-brown worm whose front end is an enormous mouth of ring after ring of razor teeth; lives in mud trenches.

naga.name: Naga
naga.role: Shadowy faeries that attack Feyre at the Suriel's snare.
naga.look: Dark scales, serpentine features on male humanoid bodies, polished black talons, amber almond eyes, razor teeth, a silvery forked tongue.

faerie.name: Faerie
faerie.role: A voice from the crowd: lesser faeries at the manor and in the woods, never named.

stranger.name: The Stranger
stranger.role: A High Fae male who steps out of the dark on Fire Night. He gives no name.

bogge.name: The Bogge
bogge.role: The thing in the brush that wants to be looked at.
